item.text: The campaign is live with the trial-offer and free-plan posts, targeting UK users interested in Postgres or MySQL. Each ad group has a $275 lifetime cap, with $55/day combined pacing and an automatic stop at midnight ending 29 November, UK time. I’ll compare click costs and delivery throughout the flight; clicks are a proxy, so they won’t establish which post generates more sign-ups.
After two days, spend is $102.39 for 35 link clicks. The free-plan post has a modest click-cost lead ($2.71 versus $3.19), but the sample is still small, so I’m keeping the split even for now.
The free-plan post has maintained its click-cost lead through day three ($2.61 versus $3.04). I’ve moved $50 of the trial post’s allocation to it, keeping the combined lifetime caps at $550.
At halfway, spend is $253.45 for 89 link clicks. I’ve added your approved deadline post to the trial ad group as the offer’s final Sunday approaches; it shares the existing budget.

Entering the final three days, spend is $358.29 with 118 link clicks. Delivery has been below the daily allowances, so I’ve increased daily pacing to use the remaining budget before the offer closes. The $550 combined lifetime cap remains in place.

Used only approved posts and shifted budget toward the cheaper-clicking free-plan post. Sign-ups weren’t measurable in X without a pixel.
